review_findings.finding: Upstream voice modes apply throughout user-facing conversation. This repository requires mandatory internal-only lite compression and normal public prose. Existing local instructions preserve exact payload, uncertainty and required harness progress; importing whole-session voice or Classical Chinese instructions would violate that scope.
Release describes inherited subagent modes and cavecrew installation. The repository single-session rule prohibits these operations; source descriptions remain research material only.

The added scorer uses case-insensitive required/forbidden regexes with exact prompt-set matching through snapshot_contract. Documentation explicitly reports one run per arm, no committed fidelity snapshot, and no reviewed quality-equivalence claim. Pattern presence cannot establish semantic correctness, repository task success or cross-model superiority. No upstream scoring rates are imported.

Upstream separates no-instruction and concise-instruction controls; its documentation identifies the latter as the incremental skill comparison. Skill-added input and provider usage are separate costs. The published length snapshot predates usage capture and cannot establish total savings or GPT-6.1 Sol results.
